contact_name.value: Bette Premo, Ph.D., founder of White Water Associates

services.value: Provides analytical laboratory services including analyzing water and soil for organic and inorganic compounds using technologies such as ICP, ICPMS, CVAFS, high pressure ion chromatography (HPIC), qPCR and dd-PCR, and UV/VIS spectrophotometers. Also offers environmental consulting services including environmental impact statements, grant and proposal writing, technical writing and editing, GIS, control of invasive species, and SCUBA.
